content: waiting event fires when readyState drops below HAVE_FUTURE_DATA while potentially playing; historically unreliable (Chrome bugs ~2014, readyState lies) but reliable as of 2019+. readyState/buffered are read-only - cannot fabricate real buffering state. Simulated buffering without network: the deterministic cross-engine approach is pause() + show spinner overlay (pointer-events:none) for N ms + resume play() with .catch() guard for autoplay policy. Seek-triggered waiting is fragile and can stall players (dash.js rapid-seek bug). Do not fabricate events on video; simulate at UI level.
